etsy.title: Out of Spoons Sticker, Spoonie Laptop Decal, Recharging Chronic Illness Gift, Neurodivergent Sticker
etsy.description:
An out of spoons sticker for spoonies: a row of spoons running low, with "recharging" underneath.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, planner, or journal. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
